nativePlatform.framework: SwiftUI with UIKit system browser integration
nativePlatform.dimensions: DESIGN.md dimensions are native points before Dynamic Type scaling, not CSS pixels.
nativePlatform.componentRendering: Descriptive native entries only. No HTML/CSS simulation of SwiftUI controls.
nativePlatform.tonalRamps: No synthetic ramps: the source defines paired appearance colors, not an authored tonal scale.
nativePlatform.shadows: No app-authored shadow tokens; native presentations own their depth.
nativePlatform.breakpoints: No authored viewport breakpoints; SwiftUI container sizing and Dynamic Type drive layout.
nativePlatform.review: Ship disposition across 14 supplied captures; no material fixes within publication scope. Real-key verification, hardware notifications and hardware animation performance are outside that visual review.

components.name: Recording action
components.description: Circular primary action with outer ring and real Morphicons microphone, stop and loader states; hold/release and VoiceOver toggle input.

narrative.overview:
Fakkerni preserves the established Cairo, monochrome, silver-orb and Morphicons identity in a native SwiftUI interface. The wire sculpture provides the expressive center; quiet surfaces and readable Arabic and English support the reminder work around it.

This is the implemented iOS system, extracted from `ios/App/Visuals.swift`, `FakkerniApp.swift`, `ReminderScreens.swift`, and `SettingsScreens.swift`. The approved identity is recorded in `PRODUCT.md`; surface composition belongs in `docs/ios-surface.md`. The finish review reports ship across all 14 supplied captures, with no material fixes in publication scope. Native dimensions here are SwiftUI points, not CSS pixels. System controls retain their platform behavior.
keyCharacteristics: Cairo across Arabic and English, with Western digits.
Near-black and near-white grounds with neutral action contrast.
A silver wire sculpture and the existing vector mark.
Native navigation, grouped forms, sheets and accessible controls.

rules.name: The Neutral Identity Rule
rules.body: Keep brand surfaces and ordinary actions monochrome. Native destructive and validation states retain their semantic treatment.

rules.name: The Bilingual Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Cairo for authored Arabic and English content, preserve Western digits, and follow the selected layout direction.

rules.name: The Tonal Surface Rule
rules.body: Use background and surface roles to distinguish app-owned containers; preserve native presentation depth for system controls.

dos: Do preserve Cairo, Western digits and the selected Arabic or English layout direction.
Do use native scrolling, forms, sheets and safe-area actions with Dynamic Type.
Do reuse the actual Morphicons data, vector mark and Canvas silver sculpture.
Do show validation and pending states before allowing approval or provider activation.
donts: Don't introduce emoji or bright yellow UI.
Don't invent fixed corner radii, CSS breakpoints or shadows for native controls.
Don't turn semantic error or completion colors into brand accents.
Don't use an account-site visit as the visual proof of a verified connection.
